svg.title: Craft backend meta-types · one connection at a time
svg.desc: One definition box per meta-type. Exactly one connection is highlighted at a time, together with its source and target. Twenty-two canonical branches and one dashed field-typing reference are shown separately, two seconds each, in a 46-second loop. The Lab logo, Paper & crimson palette and crossing-free layout are preserved.

g.text: Typed record of a fact that

svg.text: Solid arrows: canonical signatures. Dashed arrow: field typing. Entity loops relate Entity instances.
One highlighted connection at a time. All definitions remain visible. Saga is represented by Workflow.

g.text: Value Object → typed field reference → Enum
